prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Tantalum (Ta) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a soft body-hugging knit dress — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.

RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a cup in both hands, wrapped around its warm sides — her own right hand curls around the right side of the cup, her own left hand curls around the left side.

EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — tantalum: a dense, hard blue-grey metal named in 1802 for Tantalus, the king of myth punished to stand in water that drew away whenever he bent to drink, beneath fruit that lifted out of reach, because its oxide sat in strong acid without taking up any of it; nearly untouched even by aqua regia, it gave the word tantalize; for decades it was confused with its twin metal, which in 1844 was split from it and named for his daughter Niobe; the body accepts it without harm, so it makes bone implants and surgical clips; tiny tantalum capacitors hide inside phones — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
